description.en: The ID of the resource export task.

description.en: The number of results per page. Default value: 20. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 100.

导出状态

description.en:
The export status. Valid values:

- Queue: queued
- Pending: preparing to run
- Success: succeeded
- Errored: failed
- Canceled: canceled.
